comment: Consolidated emlgo 0.7 revalidation baseline (AVX2 client, Go 1.27.2). One run per engine x scale (6 runs): CPU EMLGo and GPU EMLGo, 25k/100k/250k, dim 128, 4 pinned P-cores (12-15), 500 queries each, all 15 dtypes x all 13 search modes. Does NOT replace benchmarks/baseline_cpu.json (CI gate shape: 10k/50k, float32+int8, dense, 8 workers, separate measurement host). 500k deliberately not collected (runtime).
